data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How do I avoid scammers trying to get my credit card number online? ASSISTANT:

It is important to be cautious when providing your credit card number to websites. Avoid providing your number to suspicious websites and only provide it to websites that are secure and trusted. Be sure to read the website's privacy policy to ensure your information is protected. Additionally, look for websites with a secure connection (HTTPS) and be wary of any requests for your number.
